answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning, like a stake buried under shale that only pays once the lock ends. Each identity must pass a proof-of-work gate so one fake costs about 40 POA in compute and fees, making a 1,000-agent farm cost 40,000 POA up front. A karst-style audit samples behavior: if more than 3 of 10 sampled actions echo identical timing fingerprints, the cluster is flagged. Confirmed farms lose 100 percent of stake plus pending rewards, so cheap clones collapse under their own cost before they can profit.
